description: Update any subset of fields on an existing, not-yet-submitted Stay Application. Same field set and validation rules as createStayApplication — only pass the fields you're changing. Fails with a 409 if the application has already been submitted. Requires NOMADSTAYS_MCP_AGENT_TOKEN.

monthlyPrice.description: Indicative monthly wholesale price in US dollars (USD) — the application is always priced in USD. Packages are priced in the owner's chosen currency later, after approval.

postalCountryId.description: tbCountry.CountryId — used only for the VAT check, stored on the business profile, not on the application. Use getCountryOptions.

stayCountryId.description: tbCountry.CountryId — the country the application itself is filed under. Use getCountryOptions.

name: saveStayApplication
